grid.expression: SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.DTNEG, CAB.CODTIPOPER, (SELECT DISTINCT DESCROPER FROM TGFTOP WHERE CODTIPOPER = CAB.CODTIPOPER) AS DESCRTOP, ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, ITE.CODVOL, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT I.CODPROD FROM TGFITE I INNER JOIN TGFCAB C ON I.NUNOTA = C.NUNOTA WHERE I.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD AND I.CODEMP = 1 AND C.CODTIPOPER IN (200,201,203,209,213,214,215,221,232,240,241) AND I.ATUALESTOQUE = 1 AND C.DTNEG <= :P_DATACORTE) THEN '#65e10f' ELSE '#f26c63' END AS BKCOLOR, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT IT.CODPROD FROM TGFITE IT INNER JOIN TGFCAB CA ON IT.NUNOTA = CA.NUNOTA WHERE IT.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD AND IT.CODEMP = 1 AND CA.CODTIPOPER IN (200,201,203,209,213,214,215,221,232,240,241) AND IT.ATUALESTOQUE = 1 AND CA.DTNEG <= :P_DATACORTE) THEN 'OK' ELSE 'Verificar' END AS STATUS FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD WHERE ITE.NUNOTA = :P_NUNOTA
